title: Associate Director – IT Infra Support Lead
description:
**About the Job**
-----------------

About Azentio

  

Azentio Software incorporated in 2020 at Singapore, has been carved out of 3i Infotech, Candela Labs, Beyontec Technologies and Path Solutions. Azentio Software provides mission critical, vertical-specific software products for customers in banking, financial services and insurance verticals and includes key products such as KASTLE™ (Universal Lending), AMLOCK™ (Anti-Money Laundering & Compliance software suite), iMal, PREMIA™ Astra (Core Insurance software), ORION™ (Enterprise Resource Planning software) and MFUND Plus™ (Asset Management platform). Azentio has over 800 customers in more than 60 countries, with a team of over 2,300 employees across offices in 12 countries (and growing) globally and is wholly owned by Funds advised by Apax Partners.

  

Azentio offers a comprehensive range of products – serving core operations to modern digital needs – for the financial services industry. Our deep domain knowledge and solutions in financial services extend across insurance, retail and corporate lending, Islamic Banking, anti-money laundering and asset management. In addition, Azentio proudly serves mid-market enterprises across the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and India with a comprehensive ERP solution.

  

At Azentio, we believe that growth is a continuous journey. We believe that each step of this journey must be taken by committing to excellence - excellence in our products, our services, our ideas, and our people.

  

**Job Title: Associate Director – IT Infra Support Lead**

**Years of Experience: 14+ years**

**Location: Chennai**

  
  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced leader to **own and scale internal IT infrastructure support and workplace technology operations**. This role is accountable for the **operating model, service quality, and outcomes** across end-user computing, office IT, collaboration platforms, and **L1/L2 infrastructure support**, with execution delivered through well-defined teams.

This is a leadership role focused on direction-setting, team enablement, and dependable IT operations at scale.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**L1/L2 Infrastructure Support & ITSM**

* Own the L1/L2 support model, including coverage, SLAs, escalation paths, and service quality.
* Lead teams supporting end-user devices, office IT, networking, email, and collaboration tools.
* Establish and run ITSM practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Drive root cause analysis and recurring issue reduction through data and trends.

**End-User Computing & Workplace IT**

* Lead teams responsible for laptop provisioning, asset lifecycle, and workplace IT readiness.
* Own operating standards for office IT, including networking, conference rooms, and AV setups.
* Ensure consistent onboarding and offboarding experiences through defined processes.

**Microsoft /Google & Collaboration Platforms**

* Own the operational health and administration model for Microsoft 365/Google
* Ensure effective L1/L2 support for collaboration and productivity tools.
* Promote best practices to improve reliability and user productivity.
  

  

**Systems Administration**

* Provide leadership oversight for Windows/macOS systems, directory services, and endpoint management with Intune
* Ensure systems are well-documented, stable, and consistently operated, with execution owned by teams.
* Support audits related to IT operations and access controls.
  

  

**Team Leadership & Service Excellence**

* Lead, coach, and develop IT infrastructure engineers, system administrators, and L1/L2 support teams.
* Build a service-oriented culture with clear ownership and accountability.
* Track and improve key metrics such as SLA adherence, MTTR, ticket trends, and user satisfaction.

**Vendor & Cost Management**

* Own governance of IT vendors, MSPs, and service providers.
* Manage renewals, assets, vendor performance, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Ensure vendors meet agreed service and operating standards.
  

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 14+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure support and workplace IT, with people leadership responsibility.
* Strong experience with Microsoft 365 and Google administration
* Experience in handling tools like Intune, GlobalProtect, Crowdstrike
* Experience in handline policy administration via Intune, GlobalProtect, Microsoft Entra
* Proven ability to lead teams, manage vendors, and run ITSM-driven L1/L2 operations at scale.

**Preferred Skills**

* Understanding of enterprise infrastructure setups, cloud operating models, and security fundamentals, sufficient to collaborate effectively with infrastructure and security teams.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-based service management practices.
* Strong stakeholder communication and operational leadership skills.
  

  

**What we Aim for?**

Azentio aims to be the leading provider of Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software products in Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa & United States. We will achieve this by:

  
  

* Providing world class software products, built on the latest technologies.
* Providing best in class customer service, built on a deep understanding of our domains and local nuances.
* Being an employer of choice, attracting high quality talent.
* Achieving top quartile growth and margins.
  

**Azentio Core Values:**

* **Customer centricity** - Put customers at the center of everything
* **Innovation** - Keep looking for a better way
* **Accountability** - Own your work, end-to-end
* **Results** - Focus on outcomes, not just effort

We take **Pride** in all that we do and together we **Enjoy** the journey

title: Trainee – Electronics Lab & Technical Support
description:
**Trainee – Electronics Lab & Technical Support**

**Company:** CircuitSpark  
**Location:** Valasaravakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** In person  
**Experience:** 0–2 years, based on practical skills  
**Monthly Salary:** ₹8,000–₹20,000

**About CircuitSpark**

CircuitSpark focuses on practical electronics learning, circuit building, Arduino projects, embedded systems and hands-on technical experiments.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Lab & Technical Support Trainee to assist with practical sessions, electronics project preparation, lab equipment management and basic circuit testing.

This opportunity is suitable for freshers who are interested in electronics, enjoy hands-on technical work and want to develop practical skills in a learning and project-based environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Electronics Lab Support**

* Prepare electronic components, tools, breadboards and equipment for practical sessions.
* Organise electronics kits, sensors, modules, Arduino boards and other lab materials.
* Ensure that lab equipment and project kits are ready for use.
* Maintain a clean, organised and safe electronics lab.

**2. Circuit Assembly and Testing**

* Assist with basic electronic circuit assembly and breadboard connections.
* Perform basic soldering and component replacement under supervision.
* Check circuits using a multimeter and other basic testing instruments.
* Identify simple connection errors and report faults to the trainer or engineer.
* Help verify that demonstration circuits and project kits work correctly.

**3. Arduino and Electronics Projects**

* Assist with Arduino boards, sensors, LEDs, displays, relays and other electronic modules.
* Support the preparation and demonstration of beginner-level electronics projects.
* Help with basic Arduino code uploading and circuit simulation under guidance.
* Assist in preparing project kits and practical demonstration materials.

**4. Student and Trainer Support**

* Help trainers prepare practical exercises and project materials.
* Assist students with component identification and basic circuit connections.
* Support the smooth conduct of practical sessions.
* Follow instructions from trainers and maintain proper lab discipline.

**5. Component Inventory and Maintenance**

* Sort and organise electronic components.
* Maintain component stock records and project kit checklists.
* Check received components and report shortages or damaged items.
* Keep tools, cables, modules and testing equipment in their designated places.

**Eligibility and Skills**

* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Diploma, ITI, B.Sc. or BE/B.Tech in Electronics, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation or a related discipline is preferred.
* Basic understanding of electronic components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, LEDs and transistors is an advantage.
* Interest in Arduino, sensors, circuit building and practical electronics.
* Willingness to learn soldering, circuit testing and troubleshooting.
* Basic computer skills and a responsible attitude.
* Good attention to detail, punctuality and willingness to learn.

Previous work experience is not mandatory. Candidates with practical projects, college laboratory experience or a strong interest in electronics are encouraged to apply.

Training and Growth Opportunities

The selected candidate will gain hands-on exposure to electronic components, circuit assembly, Arduino projects, basic testing instruments, electronics lab operations and embedded systems.

Practical training and guidance will be provided according to the candidate's learning progress and assigned responsibilities.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Building Automation, ELV/ICT
description:
The Team:

Cundall is an award-winning global, multi-disciplinary consultancy with a strong and growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region. Our leadership in sustainable business was recognized when Cundall received the World Green Building Council’s 2020 Business Leadership in Sustainability Award for the APAC region, reflecting our commitment to embedding sustainability into the way we work and the outcomes we deliver for the built environment.

Sustainability underpins everything we do. We empower our people to drive positive change, decarbonize the built environment and create energy-efficient, resilient and climate-responsive buildings and communities.

Our Building Services team delivers integrated, resilient and technology-led solutions for complex buildings and infrastructure. Our Building Automation, ELV and ICT specialists work across commercial, mission-critical, healthcare, hospitality and mixed-use developments, combining controls and systems-integration expertise with a practical understanding of construction, commissioning and building operations.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for a Building Automation and ELV/ICT Engineer or Senior Engineer to join our Chennai office and contribute to projects across India, the Middle East and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking an engineer with strong consultancy design experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), building automation and controls, supported by capability in Extra-Low Voltage (ELV), Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and electronic security systems.

The successful candidate will lead or develop coordinated controls and ELV designs from concept through construction and commissioning for commercial buildings, data centres and other complex facilities.

The role requires confident engagement with clients, architects, MEP engineers, contractors, controls specialists, system integrators and vendors, together with sound engineering judgement and strong technical documentation, coordination and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop Building Management System and building automation designs, including controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, network topologies, plant schematics, control-panel requirements, integration matrices and performance specifications.
* Design and coordinate controls for HVAC, central utility plants, electrical monitoring, energy metering, lighting and other building systems, with particular emphasis on mission-critical facilities and data centres.
* Define interfaces and data exchange between BMS, SCADA, EPMS, fire alarm, security, lighting control, lifts, packaged plant and other third-party systems using appropriate open protocols.
* Design ELV and ICT systems, including fire detection and alarm, voice evacuation/public address, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, structured cabling, LAN/Wi-Fi infrastructure, intercom, and other specialist systems as applicable.
* Prepare design criteria, layouts, schematics, calculations, technical specifications, equipment schedules, bills of quantities, cost inputs and tender documentation.
* Coordinate automation and ELV requirements with architectural, electrical, mechanical, fire-and-life-safety, security, IT and structural disciplines, including sensors, control devices, panels, power supplies, containment, network infrastructure and equipment-space requirements.
* Review vendor submissions, shop drawings, control schematics, software and graphics proposals, material submittals, method statements and technical deviations for compliance with the design intent and project requirements.
* Support tender evaluations, value engineering, technical clarifications and assessments of controls contractors, OEMs and system integrators.
* Contribute to BIM-led coordination and work effectively with Revit and CAD technicians to deliver accurate, coordinated drawings and models.
* Manage assigned deliverables, budgets and programmes across multiple projects while maintaining Cundall’s quality and safety expectations.

  
The Skills:

Qualifications and Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Controls, Mechatronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline.
* Typically 4–8 years of relevant consultancy or design experience for Engineer/Senior Engineer level, with demonstrable building automation or BMS experience; candidates with stronger leadership experience may be considered for a more senior position.
* Proven experience developing BMS controls philosophies, points schedules, sequences of operation, system architectures, integration requirements and commissioning documentation is essential.
* Experience producing coordinated Building Automation and ELV/ICT designs for commercial, data centre, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or large infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential; working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows is strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop technical specifications, BOQs, design reports, calculations, schematics and tender packages with limited supervision.
* Experience coordinating with clients, architects, MEP consultants, contractors, OEMs, controls specialists and system integrators.
* Familiarity with applicable Indian codes and approvals, including NBC requirements, relevant BIS/IS standards and local fire-authority expectations, together with commonly used international standards.
* Relevant certifications or training in BMS platforms, Niagara Framework, networking, RCDD, CCNA/CCNP or security systems are advantageous but not mandatory.

Technical Knowledge and Personal Attributes:

* Strong technical knowledge of BMS, HVAC controls, direct digital control, instrumentation, control panels, field devices, plant optimisation and energy-management strategies.
* Ability to write clear and technically robust sequences of operation for air-side, water-side, electrical and mission-critical systems, including normal, failure, standby and recovery modes.
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC and common API or gateway-based integration approaches, including network architecture, interoperability and cybersecurity considerations.
* Understanding of BMS, SCADA and EPMS boundaries, high-level interfaces, alarm management, trending, graphics, reporting, analytics and data-centre monitoring requirements.
* Strong knowledge of IP-based CCTV, video management systems, access control, intrusion detection, fire detection and alarm, VESDA, public address/voice evacuation and structured cabling systems.
* Understanding of copper and fibre cabling, equipment-room planning, racks, pathways, containment, power supplies and resilience requirements.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, PoE, switches, servers, storage, virtualisation and cybersecurity principles relevant to connected building systems.
* Awareness of relevant BIS/IS, NBC, ECBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, ISO/IEC, TIA/EIA, NFPA and BS/EN requirements commonly referenced on Indian and international projects.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English; additional Indian language capability is welcome.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently when required and travel to project sites within India or internationally.

If you are motivated by technically challenging projects and want to develop high-performance Building Automation solutions integrated with ELV and ICT systems for the buildings of the future, this could be the role for you.

This role will assist with software lifecycle processes, maintain accurate asset records, support licensing compliance activities, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure effective software asset management practices.

The successful candidate will work closely with IT, Procurement, Finance, and software vendors to support software asset operations, maintain data quality, and contribute to process improvements within the Software Asset Management program.

**This is a full-time position based in India and may support both local and global operations.**

*In September 2025, KBR announced that we are spinning our Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate public company. This role will ultimately be part of the new company. The Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the administration and tracking of software assets throughout their lifecycle, including requests, deployments, renewals, reclamation, and retirement.

* Assist with software asset management activities using ServiceNow SAM Pro or similar asset management tools.
* Support software reconciliation, entitlement management, normalization, and reporting processes.
* Monitor software usage and help identify opportunities for license optimization and cost savings.
* Assist with software license compliance reviews and support audit readiness activities through data gathering and documentation.

* Collaborate with IT, Procurement, Finance, and business teams to support software asset management operations.
* Support software purchasing, renewal tracking, invoice validation, and contract administration activities.
* Generate and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics related to software assets, licensing, and compliance.
* Assist with resolving software asset and licensing inquiries from internal stakeholders.
* Support data quality initiatives by validating software inventory, contract, and entitlement information.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy.
* Stay current on software licensing and asset management practices and apply established procedures consistently.

**Basic Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), software licensing, IT operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience working with asset management systems, software inventories, or license tracking processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Basic understanding of software asset lifecycle management principles.
* Familiarity with software licensing models, including SaaS and subscription-based licensing.
* Experience using ServiceNow, ServiceNow SAM Pro, or similar asset management platforms preferred.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel for reporting and analysis.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining asset and license records.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with software vendors such as Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, VMware, or similar enterprise software providers.
* Working knowledge of procurement, contract administration, or software purchasing processes.
* Experience supporting software audits and compliance activities.
* Exposure to cloud software licensing environments, including Microsoft 365, Azure, or AWS.

description:
Here's a polished and professional version of the Job Description suitable for Naukri, LinkedIn, careers pages, or internal hiring:

**Job Title: Level 2 Technical Support Executive (Desktop Support)Position Overview**

We are looking for a customer\-focused and technically proficient **Level 2 Technical Support Executive** to join our IT Support team. The ideal candidate will provide advanced technical assistance for Windows desktops, laptops, email systems, printers, and end\-user applications. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, logical problem\-solving, and the ability to support users with varying levels of technical expertise while ensuring a high standard of customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 technical support for Windows desktops and laptops, including hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and support Microsoft Outlook, Exchange, IMAP, and mobile email accounts.
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues using analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Deliver remote and onsite technical support to end\-users.
* Assist non\-technical users with patience, professionalism, and clear communication.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot network printers and print servers.
* Record incidents, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions in the IT ticketing system.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams to resolve recurring or system\-wide technical issues.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT policies, security standards, and operational procedures.
* Meet service level agreements (SLAs) while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum **1 year of experience** in IT Desktop Support or a Level 2 Technical Support role.
* Strong knowledge of **Windows 10 \& Windows 11** operating systems.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Office Suite** and common desktop applications.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting **Microsoft Outlook, Exchange, IMAP, and POP3 email services**.
* Good understanding of printer installation, network printer configuration, print server management, and troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and remote desktop tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and perform effectively in a fast\-paced support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as **CompTIA A\+**, **Microsoft Certified**, or ITIL Foundation are an added advantage.
* Experience working with ITSM or ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira, Freshservice, Zendesk, etc.) is preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer Service Orientation
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Critical Thinking
* Communication Skills
* Time Management
* Team Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Problem Solving
* Adaptability
